scope_note: Registry owns a single PostgreSQL-backed repository with strict scoped identity, immutable version content, original atomic receipts, caller CAS and durable readback. review_findings_addressed.finding: Generic entries accepted empty typed StrategySpec, with or without Idempotency-Key.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Removed duplicate generic content validation and reuse _strategy_spec_register_payload for every typed StrategySpec. Both routes require lineage and either canonical schema/identity/checksum-valid inline content or an explicit storage reference and checksum. The shared validator rejects malformed/blank references and inline pointers without content. Existing transaction-scoped revision/CAS and receipts remain in force.

review_findings_addressed.finding: Generic allocation_policy creation bypassed the canonical AllocationPolicyArtifact validator and could expose invalid approved content.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Generic creation now rejects the allocation_policy kind regardless of payload validity and key presence. Only POST /api/registry/allocation-policy-artifacts creates that kind through its existing canonical validator. Tests prove invalid creation leaves typed GET/list empty, valid typed creation/approval works and its original receipt and current approved GET survive a fresh OS process.
